import contextlib,json,os,runpy,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
library,tag=sys.argv[1:]
case=next(x for x in json.loads(Path('zig/lib/video/testdata/vision-weight-validation/production-commands.json').read_text())['cases'] if x['name']=='layers-4g')
argv=case['argv'][1:];output=Path('/private/tmp/'+tag+'.json');argv[argv.index('--output')+1]=str(output)
os.environ['DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES']=library
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('tools/embeddinggemma2').resolve()));sys.argv=argv
exit_code=0
with output.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as log,contextlib.redirect_stdout(log),contextlib.redirect_stderr(log):
 try:runpy.run_path(argv[0],run_name='__main__')
 except BaseException as error:
  traceback.print_exc();exit_code=error.code if isinstance(error,SystemExit) else 1
raise SystemExit(exit_code)
